description: Polyglot benchmark (python/react, Exercism, MIT): implement from instructions; the tests are hidden until the check.

steps.prompt: Solve the exercise in INSTRUCTIONS.md by implementing it in react.py. Use only the language's standard library. Hidden tests will check your solution against the instructions, so handle the edge cases they describe.

checks.name: hidden tests pass
checks.run: set -o pipefail; cp -a "$TASK_DIR/hidden/." . && python3 -m unittest react_test
